content.title: Kentucky vs Santa Clara basketball game recap, March Madness score
content.text: Updated March 20, 2026, 4:20 p.m. ETCoverage from the game:UK survives close call vs. Santa Clara, wins March Madness opener in OTCoverage during the game:ST. LOUIS — When Mark Pope looks at Santa Clara, he doesn't see a team that reminds him of anyone his Kentucky basketball club has faced this season."I've seen the slices of so many teams," Pope said Monday night during his weekly radio show. "Of course, we have so many teams in this league that are great offensive rebounding teams; they fit there. We have teams in this league that are terrific steals teams. We have teams that are picking up full man-to-man (defense)."So there's a lot of (similarities)."The Wildcats will try to ensure their NCAA Tournament run this season isn't undone today by the Broncos. UK, the 7-seed in the Midwest Region, squares off with a 10th-seeded Santa Clara bunch that's in the Big Dance for the first time since Steve Nash was running the show 30 years ago.Watch select 2026 NCAA Tournament games live with Fubo (free trial)Kentucky (21-13), Pope said, wouldn't be caught dead looking past a Santa Clara (26-8) squad just one victory away from matching its single-season school record for wins."Their team is a great team," Pope said. "They have tremendous length. They're shooting the ball at a tremendous clip. They'll put five guys on the floor that all really shoot it. Their backcourt is lethal. ... Their front line — 3, 4 and 5 — is so big. And their guards are really effective and get downhill and score from 8 feet just as well as from the 3-point line." Courier Journal sports reporter Ryan Black is at the Enterprise Center and will have live updates throughout the game — here and on X, formerly known as Twitter — and complete coverage after.
